{{Quote|Very good, Col. Hoot. I knew placing a spy high within the ranks of the Imperial army would pay off.|T. Morrow|<ref name="Smoke">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68195&month=012009|text="Smoke 'Em Out"|int=Smoke 'Em Out}}</ref>}}
'''T. Morrow''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[General/Legends|General]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. When [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Brady]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] was given the task of ridding [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] of vacant houses and structures, the spy [[Hoot]] contacted Morrow and reported this to him.
